Oneliner

First commercially funded, purpose-built PNT microsatellite.
Description

With the first mission, called It’s About Time, TrustPoint will focus on testing, calibration and optimization of its payload technology. After commissioning, TrustPoint will take control of the satellite and operate it through a series of tests and demonstrations. TrustPoint has not revealed the size of the cubesat nor the satellite manufacturer.
Notes

CubeSat size has not been revealed as of 2023-04-21. 3U is an educational guess based on Impulse Space news about the second satellite in December 2023.
